actions: Confirmed the source-bound AgentOpt revision is still public main.
Reproduced the official quality-stage formula directly from source: weighted mean when weights are present, but unweighted sample-SD/sqrt(n) uncertainty and z=1.645 at n>=5.
Verified the approved-case schema permits arbitrary nonnegative weights without an upper bound.
Constructed and independently enumerated a bounded 2^5 null counterexample including the default 1pp effect floor.
Confirmed adaptive Wilson reinspection, auto-holdout rotation and best-effort decision persistence from official source/tests/docs.
Searched for a protocol-matched independent AgentOpt reproduction/failure report; none was found in the targeted public search.
Persisted an independent checker, immutable audit artifact and updated role-local CURRENT pointer/state; no exploration worker state or feedback was written.

key_result.scope_correction: AgentOpt's weighted quality-stage lower bound is not a general 95% confidence bound for the weighted mean because the estimator is weighted while its SE is computed from the unweighted sample SD.
key_result.finite_counterexample: With n=5 IID symmetric deltas +/-0.02 and fixed allowed weights [100,1,1,1,1], expected weighted gain is exactly zero yet 16/32 equally likely outcomes pass the quality stage, including the default 1pp effect floor.
key_result.scope_guard: This is an exact quality-stage counterexample, not an observed end-to-end false-promotion rate; hard constraints, reliability, coverage and holdout remain separate vetoes.
key_result.additional_boundary: The unweighted z=1.645/sample-SD rule is a small-n normal approximation, and the inspected path has no anytime-valid or candidate-family statistical spending.

exact_next_action: On the next bootstrap-valid invocation, freeze the then-current control tuple, verify the then-current ACTIVE_WAVE/source integrity, and audit a different exact source member with strong runnable/raw evidence. Do not repeat unchanged AGENTOPT-CERT-SURFACE unless a recorded reopen trigger fires.
